label: LLM

shape.name: trefoil-braid-knot
shape.description: Three fine point filaments trace one continuous over-under trefoil knot, with large negative spaces and deep crossing separation.
shape.topology: closed (2,3) torus knot, three parallel micro-filaments
shape.silhouette: Continuous woven knot; crossings retain front/back depth. Not three independent flower petals.
shape.label: 三つ編みの結び目

motion.phaseMeaning: Normalized arclength, 0→1 around the closed trefoil; all three micro-strands share the same longitudinal phase.
rules: Animate brightness on anchored coordinates; never integrate particle positions over time.
Keep all structural points visible when idle, offline, or at zero activity.
Health selects one uniform color for the whole object; group is never a color category.
Use bounded, modulo-wrapped time. Activity changes speed and pulse amplitude, not the silhouette.
Reduced motion uses the rest coordinates and constant per-point weight.
motion.suggestion: Move a short bright packet continuously around the knot, with a faint second packet half a cycle behind. Do not unwind the knot or rotate its lobes independently.

provenance: Approved monitoring-galaxy point-cloud form study; final deterministic provider geometry.

rendering.seedUsage: Stable visual variation only; never make silhouette depend on seed or elapsed time.
